translation.text: I knew that I shouldn't have tried doing that by myself.

m.english: I wish you hadn't tried to help.

target.text: Eu queria que você não tivesse tentado ajudar.

translation.text: I wish you hadn't tried to help.

m.target: Eu queria que você não tivesse tentado ajudar.

m.english: You could've tried to understand his point of view.

target.text: Podias ter tentado perceber o ponto de vista dele.

translation.text: You could've tried to understand his point of view.

m.english: Should've tried harder to talk to her the first time.

target.text: Devia ter tentado falar mais com ela na primeira vez.

m.english: I have tried to keep the devil locked away, and you let him out.

target.text: Tenho tentado manter o Diabo encerrado, e tu deixaste-o sair.

translation.text: I have tried to keep the devil locked away, and you let him out.

m.target: Tenho tentado manter o Diabo encerrado, e tu deixaste-o sair.

m.english: I was tempted to go home early.

target.text: Fiquei tentado em ir para casa cedo.

translation.text: I was tempted to go home early.

m.target: Fiquei tentado em ir para casa cedo.

u.english: If he had tried anything, the rest of us would have been killed.

target.text: Se ele tivesse tentado algo, teríamos morrido todos.

u.english: I've been trying to find the right way to tell you.

target.text: Tenho tentado descobrir a melhor maneira para te contar isto.

translation.text: I've been trying to find the right way to tell you.

u.target: Tenho tentado descobrir a melhor maneira para te contar isto.

u.english: As much as I tried, I never managed to beat the final boss.

target.text: Por mais que eu tivesse tentado, não conseguia vencer o inimigo final.
